home.comingUpDetail: Starts, ends, probation and contract ends, anniversaries and documents

event.endIdentity: {{name}}'s last day; Identity turns the account off at {{time}}

people.title: People
people.description: Everyone with their department, position and manager. Everyone signed in reads this directory; the rest of a record is given out by hr.yaml.
people.name: Name

import.title: Import employees
import.description: A CSV from the old system, comma or semicolon separated, with English or Turkish headers. People are matched by work email or number.

import.doneSkipped_one: Imported {{count}} row from {{file}}. Rows {{rows}} were left out: fix them and import the file again.
import.doneSkipped_other: Imported {{count}} rows from {{file}}. Rows {{rows}} were left out: fix them and import the file again.

edit.title: Change {{name}}'s record
edit.addDetail: On the start day the joining checklist starts and, with Identity linked, the account is made.
edit.workEmailHint: They sign in with it, and Identity's account uses it.
edit.newMade: A name not in the list makes a new one.
edit.serviceStartHint: When service with you began, if before the start day (md. 54).
edit.probationDefault: Probation is two months from the start day (İş Kanunu md. 15); change it on the record.

record.directoryOnly: You read the directory part of this record
record.directoryOnlyDetail: hr.yaml gives the other parts to the person, their managers and HR.
record.saved: Saved. The change is in the record's history.

readBy.line: Read by: {{who}}. Opening it is logged.
readBy.lineDownload: Read by: {{who}}. Opening the list and each download is logged.
readBy.yourRole: those hr.yaml gives it to, which includes you

personal.description: Encrypted at rest; the person changes their own contact details
personal.nationalIdKeep: Now {{masked}}. Leave empty to keep it.
personal.shownLogged: Shown; the look is in the access log.
personal.nationalityHint: Two letters, such as TR or DE.

pay.setDetail: A new amount from a day on; the earlier ones stay in the history. Leave the amount empty to change only the bank account.
pay.payrollReads: Payroll reads the current pay each month.

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: Documents that expire, by the kinds in hr.yaml. HR is emailed once when one comes within its kind's warning time: {{warn}}.
documents.noneSoon: Nothing has expired or expires soon.
documents.noneExpire: No document with an expiry day.
documents.pick: Choose a PDF, PNG or JPEG, up to 10 MB
documents.needsExpiry: This kind needs an expiry day.
documents.addedExpires: {{kind}} added. HR is emailed once it comes within {{days}} days of expiring.
documents.removeConfirm: Delete {{name}}? It cannot be brought back.

grant.age: At least this many by age

leave.title: Leave
leave.description: Requests go through the steps their type's rule had when they were made. Nobody approves their own leave.
leave.requestGone: That request is not one you can read, or it was deleted.
leave.noSteps: Approved at once by its rule.
leave.approvedStep: Approved your step for {{name}}. {{next}} is emailed for the next step; {{name}} hears once it is decided.
leave.rejectedNotice: Rejected {{name}}'s request. They are emailed and the days go back to the balance.
leave.rejectedNoticeWhy: Rejected {{name}}'s request: {{why}}. They are emailed and the days go back to the balance.
leave.cancelledNotice: Cancelled. The days go back to the balance.
leave.askedNotice: Asked for {{days}}. {{who}} is emailed for the first step; the days are held against the balance.
leave.awayDetail: This week and next. Colleagues see that someone is away; the type only where they read the person's leave or the type is shown to colleagues.
leave.annualDetail: Granted on each anniversary of service (md. 53, 54); unused days carry over and do not expire. Each person's balance read is logged.

ask.noDocumentYet: None on the record yet; add it under Documents
ask.noteHint: Seen by those who read their leave; kept encrypted.
ask.approved: Already agreed: record it as approved

history.description: Every change, field by field; shown to those who read that part
history.label: Changes to the record

access.description: Who looked at the record, as whom and at which parts (KVKK md. 11). The person reads it too.
access.label: Looks at the record

identity.offDetail: The account is off; its sessions ended everywhere.

org.title: Org chart
org.description: Everyone working, by manager. A manager reads the work and leave parts of everyone below them, not only their direct reports.
org.emptyDetail: People appear here from their start day.

joining.title: Joining and leaving
joining.description: A checklist starts for each new person on their start day and for each end day that is set. Moving the day moves the open tasks.
joining.identityOff: Account {{email}} turned off; its sessions ended everywhere
joining.identityTurnsOff: Account {{email}} turned off on {{day}} at {{time}}; its sessions end everywhere
joining.noneDetail: One starts for each new person and for each end day that is set.
joining.leavingDetail: Setting an end day starts the leaving checklist.
joining.leavingDetailIdentity: Setting an end day starts the leaving checklist and tells Identity to turn the account off that day at {{time}}.
joining.leavingNotice: {{name}}'s last day is {{day}}; the leaving checklist has started.

me.title: My record
me.description: What HR keeps about you. You change your own phone, personal email, address and emergency contact; everything else is changed by HR.
me.lookedDetail: KVKK md. 11: you may see who read your data
me.saved: Saved. The change is in your record's history.
me.noRecord: You have no record in HR
me.noRecordDetail: HR finds your record by your work email. Signed in as {{email}}.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.description: What HR tells other products and what they read from it. Each link is set in hr.yaml.
integrations.identityDetail: Accounts follow joining, moving and leaving, through Identity's SCIM endpoint.
integrations.tokenUnset: {{name}} is not set: Identity cannot be told.
integrations.mailDetail: Leave to approve, decisions, and documents that expire.
integrations.mailOff: No mail server in hr.yaml: nobody is emailed.
integrations.payrollDetail: Each month's people, pay, bank accounts, leave days and annual balances.
integrations.payrollLogged: Each person's look is written to their access log.
integrations.absencesDetail: Who is away; a caller that does not read the person's leave sees that they are away, not the type.
integrations.apiDetail: People from your own systems, with an API token.

settings.annualDetail: İş Kanunu md. 53, by completed years of service.

settings.holidaysTr: Türkiye's, with the Bayrams; Bayram eves and 28 October are half days
settings.accessDetail: Admins read everything. Everyone signed in reads the directory.
settings.retentionValue: Records {{years}} years after the end day; the access log {{logYears}} years
